catalysts: October RBA decision priced in AONIA_2026-10 — the dated closer for the +21.5bp residual.
Follow-through housing/turnover/stamp-duty prints that confirm or reverse the 16 Sep 2026 evidence.
Any AU CPI/labor print before that meeting that tests whether inflation 82 still dominates the cooling activity/labor/consumer gauges.

context_build.causal_mechanism: Test whether the RBA can still deliver the hike that AONIA October has almost fully priced now that the mortgage/housing transmission channel is already contracting. If housing volumes, stamp-duty receipts and dwelling values keep falling, the Board's next decision cannot validate a 21.5bp October implied tightening from a 4.35 AONIA overnight without accepting a deeper activity/consumer break. The October contract is the first dated closer; a hold or a dovish skip should reprice implied AONIA toward overnight, and a delivered hike validates the market's assumption.
context_build.flow_and_positioning_check: CFTC trader-class nets and CME positioning overlays are unavailable this freeze (known gap; pos:cftc present as a block but not usable). The only flow observable on the chosen contract is ASX IB open interest and volume: October 21752 OI / 4450 volume is the liquid meeting contract; November 2619 / 1157 is usable; December volume is 2 and later months are not a positioning signal. Nothing in the packet shows a CTA/liquidation or dealer-hedge explanation for the remaining +21.5bp October gap. Do not treat the empty positioning file as evidence the trade is uncrowded.

analogs: Packet AU-US 2Y historical_move_analogs after a similar ~11.5bp 1m compression: 2022-02-07 (level -37bp, next 1m -11.7bp / 3m +38.9bp); 2024-12-30 (level -33.9bp, next 1m -8.7 / 3m +11.8); 2026-04-23 (level +86.2bp, next 1m -41.3 / 3m -54.7); 2025-07-30 (level -62.4bp, next 1m +32.7 / 3m +58.6). Forward outcomes are two-way; the 2026-04 analog continued to compress from a much richer AU-US level, while 2022-02 and 2025-07 reversed higher over 3m.

The housing research itself uses a pandemic-sized state-tax analog for the NSW stamp-duty collapse; that is a fiscal/housing episode, not a rates-path analog, and is cited only as the physical channel.
AU 2Y tenor analog list in market_state is empty; no credible same-tenor sovereign analog set is supplied, so the trade does not lean on a 2Y z-score mean-reversion analog.
historical_reference.distribution: AU 2Y 4.999 is 99.0 percentile on both 1y and 5y windows with z_1y 1.67 / z_5y 1.50; AU 10Y 5.348 is the same 99th-percentile cluster. AU 2s10s is +34.9bp (1y percentile 24.4). AU-US 2Y +25.9bp is only 25.6 percentile over 1y and 84.7 over 5y, so the local 1y history already embeds a high AU-US spread that has been compressing. AONIA October +21.5bp versus overnight is a near-full hike in the first contract, not a statistical z-score. AUDUSD 0.712 is 76th percentile 1y and is not an extreme.
historical_reference.regime_differences: 2022-02 was early global hiking with housing still expanding; today's AU inflation gauge is 82 but dwelling values and turnover are already contracting, so the transmission constraint is live rather than prospective. 2026-04 started from AU-US 2Y +86bp versus +26bp now, so that analog's continued compression is not a like-for-like level. The Fed has already hiked 25bp on 2026-09-16 to 3.75-4.00% with SOFR jumping to 3.85 on 2026-09-17; that US impulse was absent from the 2024-12 analog window. Temperature gauges are dashboard_v8 retained, so they are a stale independent check rather than a live Supabase print.

independent_checks: Physical housing (mw_20260916_au_housing_tightening): NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% YoY in August, transaction volumes -18%, Sydney and Melbourne values more than 7% below peak.
Policy path versus gauges: AONIA Oct/Nov implied 4.565/4.685 against overnight 4.35, while AU inflation 82 is hot but activity 54, labor 50 and consumer 48 are already cooling.
Sovereign confirmation, not the thesis: AU 2Y 4.999 after +39.1bp over 1m and only -5.5bp on the housing day, so the STIR October gap has not been fully digested in cash 2s.
Cross-market negative check: AUDUSD 0.712 is not stretched (76th percentile, 1m +0.20%), and US SR3 still prices 4.32 by Dec-2026, so fading AUD spot would mix a Fed residual into an RBA event.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known before this freeze: AU inflation temperature 82, RBA already tight enough that AONIA sits at 4.35, and the Fed entered Sep 16 with >90% odds of a 25bp hike which it delivered. Genuinely new in the packet: 2026-09-16 housing evidence that NSW stamp-duty receipts fell 24% YoY in August, transaction volumes fell 18%, and Sydney and Melbourne home values are down more than 7% from peak; the same-day rollup that the housing downturn is deepening under higher rates. That is a new transmission observation, not a restatement of the inflation level. Unknown: the precise October RBA calendar date, the next CPI print, and CFTC/CME ownership of IB.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: Disagree that the October meeting can still deliver that near-full hike after the housing channel has already produced a pandemic-sized stamp-duty hole and a >7% peak-to-trough in the two largest city markets. Inflation 82 can keep the Board hawkish in prose; it does not automatically make a second hike in the next IB window the base case once activity 54, labor 50 and consumer 48 are already cooling. The mispricing is the October residual, not the 99th-percentile AU 2Y level by itself.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: AONIA October implied 4.565 versus overnight 4.35 requires the market to treat a 25bp October RBA hike as the modal outcome (~21.5bp of 25bp, about 86% of a hike in a linear mapping). November 4.685 then requires additional residual tightening. The 2027 peak near 4.945 requires roughly 59.5bp of extra hikes from today. AU 2Y at 4.999 is consistent with that full cycle, not with a hold. The priced assumption is that housing pain is the intended transmission of a still-incomplete inflation fight, not a constraint that stops the next meeting.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Multi-horizon AU front-end: AU 2Y as_of 2026-09-16 is 4.999 (1y/5y percentiles both 99.0), with packet moves 1m +39.1bp, 5d +16.4bp and 1d -5.5bp. That path is a one-month bear-flattening selloff into higher hike odds, then a one-day dip on the housing/Fed week rather than a completed unwind. AONIA overnight is 4.35 (17-Sep-2026). Tradable ASX 30-day path: 2026-09 4.355 (+0.5bp), 2026-10 4.565 (+21.5bp, OI 21752, volume 4450), 2026-11 4.685 (+33.5bp, OI 2619, volume 1157), 2026-12 4.725 (+37.5bp, volume 2), then a slow grind to a 4.945 peak in 2027-07/08/09. Cross-market, AU-US 2Y is +25.9bp as_of 2026-09-16 after a 1d -12.5bp move (AU yields dipped while US yields jumped on the Sep 16 Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%). AUDUSD 0.712 is only +0.20% over 1m and -0.74% over 5d, so spot has not been the instrument that absorbed the hike residual.

policy_path_check.rationale: A front-end AU rates trade must start from the live AONIA/IB path, not from the AU 2Y percentile. The US SR3 path is the independent reason the spot alternative (short AUDUSD) is inferior: the Fed residual is still in USD and would dominate an AUDUSD expression of an RBA skip.

context_build.price_decomposition: Level versus change: overnight AONIA 4.35 is the policy-adjacent cash benchmark; the marginal priced tightening is the +21.5bp October IB gap, then +12.0bp more into November, then only +4.0bp into December. Liquidity is concentrated in October (volume 4450) and fades to 1157 then 2. Sovereign AU 2Y 4.999 sits near the 2027 AONIA peak (4.945), so the 2Y is pricing the cycle while the first STIR contract is the event option on the next meeting. The 1d AU 2Y -5.5bp and AU-US 2Y -12.5bp are the start of a digest, not a completed repricing of the +21.5bp October gap. US SR3 is a separate decomposition: SOFR 3.85, SR3U6 4.00, SR3Z6 4.32, SR3H7 4.58, SR3U7 4.755; that residual Fed path is why AUDUSD is a dirty hedge.

catalyst-junkie.invalidation: A delivered 25bp RBA hike that ratifies the October implied 4.565, or a subsequent AU inflation outcome that keeps the inflation gauge at the current 82 while housing volumes and stamp-duty receipts stabilize rather than deepen.

The market is assuming housing pain is compatible with another hike; the disagreement is that the next meeting cannot both acknowledge that channel and still deliver the priced 25bp.

catalyst-junkie.thesis: Fact: the October AONIA contract still implies 4.565 against a 4.35 overnight after a 16 Sep housing print that shows the RBA tightening channel already biting. Inference: that is too much hike for a Board staring at falling turnover, a stamp-duty collapse and cooling activity/labor/consumer gauges, so the dated October decision is the mechanism that should reprice the contract lower if they hold. Unknown: whether inflation 82 is sufficient for them to hike through the housing evidence. Valuation without that meeting can stay wrong; the meeting is why this is a trade rather than a 99th-percentile AU 2Y fade.
why_now: Housing evidence published 2026-09-16 is new relative to an AONIA path that still has +21.5bp in the first meeting-window contract.
AU 2Y has given back only 5.5bp of a 39.1bp 1m selloff, so cash yields have not already done the STIR's job.
October IB is the liquid contract (volume 4450 versus 2 in December); the catalyst and the markable instrument coincide.
Funded seats pay official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 on the full $100m even if flat; a positive-expected-value dated event is preferable to sitting through the vig with no risk.

The testable claim is that the live AONIA strip still prices that extra tightening as if the housing channel were not yet binding.

The 4.755 peak is too low and/or the subsequent ease is too early.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: The SOFR curve requires about +90.5bp of tightening from overnight 3.85% into a Sep-2027 peak of 4.755%, then a modest ease (about 16.5bp from that peak to 4.59% by Dec-2028). US 2Y at 4.76 is already aligned with that peak. The priced assumption is that this hiking sequence is nearly fully mapped, that 4.75% is close to terminal, and that yields at 1y 99-100th percentiles should start mean-reverting once the meeting is out of the way.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Multi-horizon US front-end: US 2Y at 4.76 as of 2026-09-18, +13bp 5d, +57bp 1m and 3m, +9bp on 18 Sep after the meeting (market_state US_2Y). US 2s10s collapsed to 25bp (1y percentile 0.20; -21bp 1m; 33bp on 11 Sep to 27bp on 16 Sep to 25bp on 18 Sep), a hiking-cycle flatten as the front end led. Policy path: overnight SOFR 3.62% on 16 Sep then 3.85% on 17 Sep, matching the 25bp funds hike to 3.75-4.00%. SR3 strip: 2026-09 4.00, 2026-12 4.32, 2027-03 4.58, 2027-06 4.72, 2027-09 4.755 peak, then 2027-12 4.73 / 2028-03 4.695 / 2028-09 4.62 / 2028-12 4.59. FX confirmation: EURUSD 1.1652 on 9 Sep to 1.1537 on 16 Sep to 1.146 on 18 Sep; USDCHF +3.337% 1m to a 99.80 1y percentile. CA-US 2Y widened to -140bp (-17bp 1m, 3.8th 1y percentile): US continues to outyield Canada rather than the gap mean-reverting.

policy_path_check.pricing_summary: US overnight SOFR 3.85% effective 2026-09-17 (Fed funds 3.75-4.00% after the 16 Sep +25bp hike). SR3 implied: 2026-09 4.00 (+15bp vs overnight), 2026-12 4.32 (+47bp), 2027-03 4.58 (+73bp), 2027-06 4.72 (+87bp), 2027-09 4.755 (+90.5bp, curve peak), then 2027-12 4.73 / 2028-03 4.695 / 2028-06 4.66 / 2028-09 4.62 / 2028-12 4.59. Exact-horizon funding forwards: 3m SR3Z6 4.32, 6m SR3H7 4.58, 12m SR3U7 4.755. CA and AU paths exist but are not the selected trade: CORRA 2.29 with +136.5bp to 3.655 by 2028-09; AONIA 4.35 with +59.5bp to 4.945 by 2027-07/09.
policy_path_check.rationale: Selected instrument is SOFR_2027-09 on the tradable SOFR curve, so the US policy path is the required context. A 2Y sovereign percentile is not the substitute: the 4.76 US 2Y is used only as a confirming price trend after the SOFR/SR3 path is stated. Status is available in market_state.policy_paths.countries.US.

context_build.price_decomposition: Level vs change: US 2Y 4.76 is a 100th 1y percentile LEVEL; the TRADEABLE change is the still-positive 1m/+57bp and post-hike +9bp impulse, not the percentile. Tenor: the policy component lives in SOFR/SR3, not in the 10Y/30Y (10Y 5.01, 30Y 5.34) which add term-premium residual. Marginal driver of the last week is the delivered hike plus the still-hot CPI/labor complex, visible as SOFR 3.62->3.85, 2s10s 33->25bp, and EURUSD 1.1537->1.146. Cross-market: CA CORRA overnight 2.29 with +136.5bp priced to a 2028-09 3.655 peak is a catch-up path, not a reason to fade US; CA labor 38 and core CPI near 2% argue that catch-up can disappoint, which would keep CA-US 2Y wide. AU is the anti-analog: AONIA 4.35 with ~60bp more priced but housing already biting (stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y, home values >7% off peak).

rollup:BoJ raises its policy rate to 1.25%
rollup:BoE holds 3.75% with three votes for a hike

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Pay/short SOFR_2027-09 (SR3U7) at packet implied 4.755; owns persistence of the post-hike US tightening path and rejects the modest easing priced after the Sep-2027 peak.
expression_comparison.rationale: Rates and spot both continue the same Fed-hike/USD-premium impulse, so rates is the default. SOFR_2027-09 is the cleaner owner: it is markable from tradable_rate_curves, sits on an observed policy path (overnight SOFR 3.85 vs SR3U7 4.755 then easing to 4.59 by Dec-2028), and is the exact tenor where a premature fade would show up. USDCHF is the stronger spot trend but is already a 99.8th-percentile statistical extreme without adding policy-path information and mixes CHF-idiosyncratic residual. Do not default to options: packet has no premium/IV/strike mids.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Long USDCHF at packet ECB spot 0.8256544502617802 (1y percentile 99.80, +3.337% 1m); alternative G10 USD-up expression is short EURUSD at 1.146 (1y percentile 10.91, -1.892% 1m).

trend-follower.horizon: 1-3 months, through subsequent US CPI and the next FOMC path revision
trend-follower.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if the US policy path re-prices the Sep-2027 implied back toward overnight SOFR 3.85 rather than holding or raising the packet 4.755 peak, or if packet-equivalent evidence shows the Fed tightening bias reversed and US inflation and labor gauges both roll over. A 100th-percentile US 2Y/10Y print is not invalidation. Do not invent a price stop.
trend-follower.mispricing: Market implies a ~90bp hiking remainder to 4.755% by Sep-2027 and then a small ease. That prices a nearly complete cycle just as realized overnight has only moved to 3.85% and as US inflation/labor/consumer have not rolled over. The fade camp treats 99-100th percentile UST yields as the opportunity. This seat treats those percentiles as the trend. Edge is further cheapening of SR3U7 (higher implied) if the peak is revised up or the ease is delayed, not carry from merely delivering the already-priced path.
principal_risks: The 4.755 peak already maps ~90bp of further hikes; if that path is merely delivered with no peak revision, expected P&L may not clear the 3.85% SOFR funding vig.
Positioning is unavailable; a crowded short-duration base could squeeze on any growth scare even if the medium-term trend is intact.
Temperature gauges are dashboard_v8 retained and marked stale if Supabase live scores are absent; a true labor break that is not in this freeze would flip the seat.
Australia already shows the tightening channel biting in housing; a US analog that is not in this packet would be a late-cycle fade the seat currently rejects.
Energy shock-absorber weakness and the Saudi workaround cut both ways: they can keep inflation sticky (supports pay) or hit growth (supports a fade).
trend-follower.structure: Pay/short packet-markable SOFR_2027-09 (exchange code SR3U7) in implied-rate space. Book marks at tradable_rate_curves / funding_context implied 4.755, price 95.245. Direction profits if implied SOFR for Sep-2027 rises (futures price falls). Same-direction add in SOFR_2027-12 / SOFR_2028-03 only if those contracts remain the easing-dip expression of the same thesis; do not migrate the open onto a bond (US_2Y) family.
trend-follower.thesis: FACT: The Fed delivered a 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%, official SOFR is 3.85%, August CPI kept the tightening bias, US gauges are 72/75/69/74, US 2Y is 4.76 with a +57bp 1m impulse and a further +9bp on 18 Sep, and SR3 peaks at 4.755 in Sep-2027 then eases. INFERENCE: Price, policy and macro are aligned for continuation of higher US short-end rates; a fade of 100th-percentile yields right after a hike with still-hot gauges is the classic premature mean-reversion this seat rejects. The mispricing is the assumption that 4.755 is close enough to terminal that one should receive the peak or buy the post-peak dip. UNKNOWN: positioning, live (non-v8) gauges, NZ rates. Primary expression is pay SOFR_2027-09. Spot USDCHF/EURUSD confirms but is inferior.
why_now: The September hike that was >90% priced has been delivered; residual information is the PATH, visible in US 2Y still rising on 18 Sep and SOFR printing 3.85% on 17 Sep.
August CPI kept the Fed tightening bias intact and US inflation/labor/consumer/activity gauges remain 72/75/69/74, so there is no reversal catalyst for a fade.

Funded seats pay official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 on the full $100m even if flat; a defined continuation trade with invalidation is required to clear that hurdle rather than sitting out a live hiking trend.
Global policy impulse is still one-way this freeze (Fed hike, BoJ to 1.25%, BoE three votes for a hike), which argues against treating the US yield spike as a one-and-done event.

trend-follower.core_view: Post-hike US tightening and the UST yield uptrend persist; fading 100th-percentile yields or the modest SR3 post-peak ease is premature while US gauges stay hot.
trend-follower.key_catalyst: Next US CPI/labor or FOMC path revision that lifts the SR3 Sep-2027 peak above the packet 4.755 implied.
trend-follower.key_invalidation: US policy path re-prices Sep-2027 implied back toward overnight SOFR 3.85, or inflation and labor gauges both roll over with the tightening bias reversed.
